players.name: Justin Herbert
players.note: As of Nov. 24 he was still in the concussion protocol after the Nov. 22 loss to the Jets, and Jim Harbaugh said he must clear every step before playing. Betting lines suggest he will miss Nov. 29 vs. New England, with DJ Uiagalelei starting, and some reports raise the chance of a season-ending shutdown.

players.name: Drake Maye
players.note: He reportedly has a fibula fracture in his ankle, suffered Nov. 15 in Munich; it doesn't require surgery, but he is out indefinitely and possibly for the season. Tommy DeVito will start Week 12 vs. the Chargers.

players.name: Tommy DeVito
players.note: New England is sticking with him as its starter for Week 12 vs. the Chargers on Nov. 29 while Drake Maye (fibula fracture) is out. He went 12-of-24 for 81 yards, 1 TD and 1 INT in relief on Nov. 15.

players.name: Sam Darnold
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 12:20 AM PT Nov 26.

players.name: Drew Lock
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (elbow) as of 12:20 AM PT Nov 26. Earlier: Sam Darnold is expected to return and start Nov. 29 vs. the 49ers, per Mike Macdonald on Nov. 23, which sends Lock back to the bench.

players.name: Kyler Murray
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (hamstring) as of 6:25 AM PT Nov 25. Earlier: Minnesota is still targeting a Nov. 29 return vs. Atlanta from his Grade 2 hamstring strain. No Week 12 practice participation had been confirmed as of Nov. 24.

players.name: Kirk Cousins
players.note: He started Week 11 (235 yards, 0 TD, 1 INT on Nov. 22), but Kyler Murray is targeting a Nov. 29 return vs. Atlanta that would send Cousins back to the bench.

players.name: Dak Prescott
players.note: He hurt his left hand in Week 11, when he had 325 yards and 4 passing TD plus a rushing TD. He practiced in full Monday (Nov. 23) and should be fine for Thanksgiving.

players.name: Baker Mayfield
players.note: He played through a foot/ankle injury on Nov. 22 and took several big hits but finished the game, scoring 19.1 PPR points. He is expected to play in Week 12; watch the Wednesday practice report.

players.name: Jayden Daniels
players.note: He hurt his left hand on Nov. 23 MNF but returned and led the winning drive. No setback had been reported as of Nov. 24; watch the Week 12 practice reports.

players.name: Daniel Jones
players.note: Indianapolis released him Nov. 20, and no signing had been reported as of Nov. 24, so he has no starting role.

players.name: Lamar Jackson
players.note: He remains on IR after surgery on his right thumb, with a reported 6-9 week timeline. Jacoby Brissett is starting.

players.name: Jacoby Brissett
players.note: He remains Baltimore's starter with Lamar Jackson on IR. He threw for 276 yards, 1 TD and 1 INT on Nov. 22.

players.name: Jalen Hurts
players.note: He remains on IR and is expected to miss the rest of 2026. Joe Milton is starting for Philadelphia.

players.name: Joe Milton
players.note: He remains the Eagles' starter with Jalen Hurts on IR, but he managed only 141 yards and 0 TD on Nov. 22 ahead of the Thanksgiving game at Dallas.

players.name: Jaxson Dart
players.note: He remains on IR after knee surgery and is expected to miss the rest of the regular season.

players.name: J.J. McCarthy
players.note: He is starting for the Giants with Jaxson Dart on IR, but he had only 173 passing yards on Nov. 22, and Jameis Winston is taking the goal-line snaps.

players.name: Malik Willis
players.note: He is on IR (groin/core) with an estimated return of Dec. 13, and surgery isn't expected. He should reclaim the job from Kyle McCord when healthy.

players.name: Kyle McCord
players.note: He is starting only while Malik Willis is on IR (estimated return Dec. 13), and he threw for just 102 yards with 0 TD on Nov. 22.

players.name: Josh Jacobs
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (finger) as of 12:20 AM PT Nov 26.

players.name: Kaleb Johnson
players.note: With Josh Jacobs (finger) questionable and not expected to play tonight (Nov. 25) at the Rams, Johnson should lead Green Bay's backfield again, with Pierre Strong Jr. also involved.

players.name: Kyren Williams
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 6:25 AM PT Nov 25. Earlier: Williams (toe) has no injury designation for tonight's Nov. 25 game vs. Green Bay after practicing fully, so he is set to play. He is still likely to share some work with Blake Corum.

players.name: Saquon Barkley
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 6:25 AM PT Nov 25. Earlier: Barkley (neck/stinger, illness) was upgraded to a full practice Tuesday, Nov. 24, and is expected to play Thursday at Dallas on Thanksgiving.

players.name: Kenneth Walker III
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (groin) as of 3:37 PM PT Nov 25.

players.name: Emmett Johnson
players.note: Kenneth Walker III (groin) was only limited Tuesday, Nov. 24, and Andy Reid said he doesn't expect Walker to see a ton of work Thursday vs. Buffalo even if he plays. Johnson should still handle most of the carries after 23 carries for 105 yards and a TD in Week 11.

players.name: Woody Marks
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (concussion) as of 6:25 AM PT Nov 25. Earlier: Reports on Nov. 24 say Marks (concussion) is expected to practice Wednesday and is trending toward playing Sunday vs. Baltimore; DeMeco Ryans is 'hopeful' to have him. He still has to clear the protocol.

players.name: Derrick Henry
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (concussion) as of 3:37 PM PT Nov 25.

players.name: J.K. Dobbins
players.note: Sleeper now lists him suspended (personal) as of 3:37 PM PT Nov 25. Earlier: Denver suspended Dobbins for one game for conduct reasons on Nov. 24, so he'll miss Week 12 vs. Pittsburgh. He had already lost the lead role to Jonah Coleman, with 1 carry on Nov. 22.

players.name: Jonah Coleman
players.note: Coleman stays Denver's clear lead back after 24 carries for 111 yards and 3 TDs on Nov. 22, and J.K. Dobbins was suspended one game on Nov. 24. Tyler Badie was activated from IR the same day but is only a depth piece.

players.name: Omarion Hampton
players.note: Hampton has handled 65% and 47% of the Chargers' carries the last two weeks, and backup Keaton Mitchell (knee/back) played two snaps in Week 11 and is uncertain for Week 12 vs. New England. That could push even more work to Hampton.

players.name: Ollie Gordon II
players.note: Gordon is Miami's lead back with De'Von Achane out for the season (ACL). Jeff Hafley said this week that Jaylen Wright aggravated an injury, which leaves Kaytron Allen as the main other back.

players.name: Bhayshul Tuten
players.note: Liam Coen said Nov. 23 that Tuten's ankle re-aggravation 'wasn't too bad,' but reports say Jacksonville may want to protect him for the playoff push. Wednesday's practice report ahead of Sunday's game vs. Tennessee is the key update.

players.name: Chris Rodriguez Jr.
players.note: He's a top Week 12 waiver add as Bhayshul Tuten's (ankle) backup, and he would lead the Jaguars' backfield vs. Tennessee if Tuten sits. Coen called Tuten's re-aggravation 'not too bad' on Nov. 23.

players.name: Jacory Croskey-Merritt
players.note: Washington activated Croskey-Merritt (groin) from IR on Nov. 23, and he led the backfield in that night's win over Cincinnati with 13 carries for 54 yards and a TD plus 2 catches for 23 yards.

players.name: Rachaad White
players.note: White was active Nov. 23 vs. Cincinnati but had no carries or catches, while Jacory Croskey-Merritt handled 13 carries. His fantasy role has dried up.

players.name: Chase Brown
players.note: Brown had 6 carries for 6 yards and 5 catches for 30 yards in the Nov. 23 loss at Washington, while Samaje Perine was more productive. That raises the risk of a committee.

players.name: Samaje Perine
players.note: Perine out-produced Chase Brown on Nov. 23 with 6 carries for 26 yards and 4 catches for 71 yards on roughly half the snaps.

players.name: Dylan Sampson
players.note: Sampson has out-snapped Quinshon Judkins in three straight games, so Cleveland's backfield is now a 50-50 committee. Raheim Sanders was also activated from IR on Nov. 24, adding depth.

players.name: Quinshon Judkins
players.note: Dylan Sampson has out-snapped Judkins in three straight games, so Cleveland's backfield is roughly a 50-50 committee and Judkins' weekly ceiling is lower.

players.name: David Montgomery
players.note: Montgomery took 26 carries for 107 yards in his Week 11 return, but Woody Marks (concussion) is trending toward playing Week 12 vs. Baltimore per Nov. 24 reports, which would likely cut into his workload.

players.name: Tony Pollard
players.note: With Tyjae Spears on IR since Nov. 21, Pollard had 21 carries for 110 yards in Week 11 and is set for a heavy workload vs. Jacksonville.

players.name: Alvin Kamara
players.note: Kamara played 8 of 72 snaps on Nov. 22 with 1 carry, while Travis Etienne Jr. took 14 carries. He has been reduced to a change-of-pace role.

players.name: Travis Etienne Jr.
players.note: Etienne led New Orleans with 14 carries for 76 yards on Nov. 22, while Alvin Kamara got 1 carry, making him the Saints' early-down back.

players.name: Justice Hill
players.note: Hill had 6 carries for 69 yards and a TD plus 4 catches on Nov. 22 and has 23 targets over Baltimore's last four games. Derrick Henry has cleared the concussion protocol, which caps Hill's rushing upside.

players.name: Jeremiyah Love
players.note: A Nov. 23 update says Love (high ankle sprain, IR since Nov. 3) will miss at least one more game; Week 13 is the earliest he could be activated.

players.name: Terrance Ferguson
players.note: Sean McVay said on Nov 23 that Ferguson will not be activated from IR as planned. His ankle has not responded, and he needs season-ending surgery. Tyler Higbee, Colby Parkinson, Davis Allen and Max Klare will keep handling the Rams' TE work.

players.name: Dalton Kincaid
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (thumb) as of 6:25 AM PT Nov 25. Earlier: Kincaid (thumb) was estimated as limited on Monday and Tuesday ahead of Thursday's Week 12 game against the Chiefs, and reports call him 'most likely' to play. He missed Week 11.

players.name: Sam LaPorta
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 6:25 AM PT Nov 25. Earlier: LaPorta (ankle) was upgraded from limited to a full practice on Tuesday, Nov 24 (an estimate from a walkthrough). He looks on track to play against the Bears on Thanksgiving.

players.name: Dallas Goedert
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 6:25 AM PT Nov 25. Earlier: Goedert (shin) was upgraded to full on the Eagles' Tuesday, Nov 24 estimated report, and the team expects him to play against the Cowboys on Thanksgiving. He drew only 1 target in Week 11.

players.name: Brock Bowers
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (ankle) as of 6:25 AM PT Nov 25. Earlier: Bowers (ankle/quad) missed Week 11. As of Nov 23-24 reports, the Raiders are optimistic he can return in Week 12, but he will need to show he is healthy at practice this week.

players.name: Juwan Johnson
players.note: Johnson's hamstring injury was still under additional evaluation in Nov 23 reports, after he played only 27 of 72 snaps in Week 11 with 1 target. He remains questionable for Week 12.

players.name: Hunter Henry
players.note: Drake Maye (fractured fibula) is expected to miss significant time, so Tommy DeVito starts at QB for the Patriots coming out of their Week 11 bye. That lowers Henry's ceiling.

players.name: T.J. Hockenson
players.note: In his Week 11 return on Nov 22, Hockenson caught 6 of 7 targets for 55 yards on 34 of 67 snaps. With Jordan Addison out after thumb surgery, his target share should stay strong as his snaps ramp up.

players.name: Brandon Aiyuk
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was out (did not report)) as of 6:25 AM PT Nov 25. Earlier: The 49ers released him and he cleared waivers on Nov 24. He has not signed anywhere yet, but his agent says he visits Washington on Nov 25 and is expected to work out there. He has not played since his October 2024 knee injury, and reports suggest any deal this season could start on a practice squad.

players.name: Antonio Williams
players.note: He had 9 catches for 122 yards on a team-high 11 targets in the Nov 23 MNF win over Cincinnati. Washington hosts free agent Brandon Aiyuk for a visit and workout on Nov 25, so watch whether Aiyuk signs and adds receiver competition.

players.name: A.J. Brown
players.note: Sleeper now lists him doubtful (hamstring) as of 6:25 AM PT Nov 25. Earlier: Sleeper now lists him doubtful (hamstring) for Week 12 at the Chargers on Nov 29. ESPN's Schefter reported he is expected to miss multiple weeks, and Vrabel said Tommy DeVito will start at QB in Week 12.

players.name: Davante Adams
players.note: Reports at the start of Week 12 say his practice window has not been opened, so he remains on IR as of Nov 24-25. That makes a Week 12 return unlikely, after McVay had pointed to the short end of a 6-10 week timeline following his late-October hamstring surgery.

players.name: Brenen Thompson
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (hamstring) as of 6:25 AM PT Nov 25. Earlier: Sleeper upgraded him from out to questionable (hamstring) as of Nov 25, after he missed four straight games. That points to a possible return in Week 12 vs. New England, but the week's practice reports will decide it.

players.name: Drake London
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 6:25 AM PT Nov 25. Earlier: Sleeper has dropped his questionable (head) tag as of Nov 25, after reports said he cleared a concussion check during Atlanta's Week 11 bye. He looks on track for Week 12 at Minnesota.

players.name: DJ Moore
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 6:25 AM PT Nov 25. Earlier: He was left off Buffalo's first Week 12 injury report (week of Nov 24), so his knee/leg issue no longer looks like a concern. That follows 8 catches for 91 yards and a TD in Week 11.

players.name: Caleb Douglas
players.note: He drew 10 targets in Week 11 but caught only 2 of them, his third straight game with 8 or more targets. NFL.com listed him among the top Week 12 waiver targets on Nov 24.

players.name: Adonai Mitchell
players.note: Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) missed Week 11 and his status for Week 12 is in doubt, which leaves Mitchell as the Jets' WR2. Isaiah Williams is also out.

players.name: Christian Watson
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (concussion) as of 12:20 AM PT Nov 26. Earlier: Footballguys lists Jayden Reed (neck) out for Green Bay's Nov 25 game at the Rams. That should mean more targets for Watson.

players.name: Jack Bech
players.note: On Nov 24, NBC Sports recommended stashing him as a pickup in case Brock Bowers' ankle injury keeps Bowers out longer. Bech has been trending up in Las Vegas.

players.name: Jalen Coker
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 6:25 AM PT Nov 25. Earlier: Sleeper no longer lists him questionable as of Nov 25. NBC Sports noted on Nov 24 that he has been the WR67 in fantasy points per game since Week 3 and faces the toughest remaining schedule among receivers.

players.name: Germie Bernard
players.note: He played 67 of 71 snaps on Nov 22 at Philadelphia and caught 6 of 10 targets for 40 yards, while DK Metcalf had just 1 catch. Bernard's role is growing.

players.name: DK Metcalf
players.note: He caught 1 of 4 targets for 2 yards on 44 of 71 snaps on Nov 22, while rookie Germie Bernard drew 10 targets. Roman Wilson was also activated from IR that day, which adds target competition.

players.name: Brian Thomas Jr.
players.note: He played only 37 of 72 snaps vs. the Giants on Nov 22 and caught 1 of 3 targets for an 18-yard TD. Jakobi Meyers drew 10 targets in the same game.

players.name: Elijah Sarratt
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was out) as of 6:25 AM PT Nov 25. Earlier: He was a healthy scratch on Nov 22, his second straight coach's-decision inactive. He has no clear path to playing time in Baltimore without an injury.

players.name: Alec Pierce
players.note: He remains on IR (heel). On Nov 11, Shane Steichen said he was unsure whether Pierce would return in 2026.

players.name: Denzel Boston
players.note: Sleeper still lists him questionable (toe) as of Nov 25, and the injury first appeared on Nov 24. Watch Cleveland's Week 12 practice reports.

players.name: Jordan Addison
players.note: Sleeper now lists him doubtful (thumb) as of 6:25 AM PT Nov 25. Earlier: Addison (thumb surgery) missed Week 11. Week 12 reports on Nov 24 say he is recovering well but is unlikely to play this week, and Tai Felton has been taking his targets.

players.name: Michael Pittman Jr.
players.note: Pittman (foot, IR) is trending toward activation. Mike McCarthy said this week he is 'very confident' Pittman returns for Week 12 vs. Denver.

players.name: Roman Wilson
players.note: Wilson played about 48 snaps in his first game back from IR on Nov 22 at Philadelphia, catching 3 of 6 targets for 43 yards. Michael Pittman Jr. is expected back from IR in Week 12, which would likely cut into Wilson's role.

players.name: Romeo Doubs
players.note: Doubs (shoulder, IR) could return to practice this week, per Week 12 reports on Nov 24. A.J. Brown (hamstring) is doubtful, so Doubs could step into a larger role once he is activated.

players.name: Michael Wilson
players.note: Wilson is out for the season after a back/neck fracture suffered Nov 8 vs. Seattle. Harrison Wallace III led Arizona's wideouts in Week 11.

players.name: Terry McLaurin
players.note: McLaurin is out for the 2026 season after tearing his left patellar tendon on Oct 19. Rookie Antonio Williams (9-122 on MNF Nov 23) has emerged as Washington's top receiver.

players.name: Omar Cooper Jr.
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (ankle) as of 6:25 AM PT Nov 25. Earlier: Cooper (ankle/hip) missed the Jets' Nov 22 win over the Chargers. It was his third ankle injury this year, and he could miss multiple weeks.

players.name: Ladd McConkey
players.note: McConkey returned from a back injury on Nov 22 in a full-time role (5-37-2 on 8 targets vs. the Jets). Justin Herbert's concussion status headlines the Week 12 injury reports and clouds the outlook vs. New England.

players.name: Tre' Harris
players.note: With McConkey back full-time on Nov 22, Harris fell to 2 catches for 28 yards on 2 targets vs. the Jets. Justin Herbert is also in the concussion protocol.

players.name: Mike Evans
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (achilles) as of 3:37 PM PT Nov 25. Earlier: Evans returned from Achilles tendinitis on Nov 22 after missing three games. He caught 6 of 7 targets for 109 yards and a TD vs. Minnesota on just 23 snaps.

players.name: Keenan Allen
players.note: With Mike Evans back on Nov 22, Allen was held to 3 catches for 38 yards on 4 targets vs. Minnesota, so his fill-in role is shrinking.

players.name: Makai Lemon
players.note: With DeVonta Smith back on Nov 22, Lemon managed 1 catch for 3 yards on 3 targets vs. Pittsburgh. His fill-in WR1 volume is gone.

players.name: Pat Bryant
players.note: With Jaylen Waddle back from his concussion on Nov 22, Bryant slipped to 3 catches for 32 yards on 4 targets vs. Las Vegas.

players.name: Skyler Bell
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was out) as of 6:25 AM PT Nov 25. Earlier: Bell was a coach's-decision inactive for Week 11 vs. Miami on Nov 22, which leaves him outside Buffalo's receiver rotation for now.

players.name: Parker Washington
players.note: Washington drew 17 targets at the Giants on Nov 22, catching 8 for 103 yards, which cements his lead role in Jacksonville's injury-thinned receiver room.

players.name: Ted Hurst III
players.note: Hurst caught 5 of 7 targets for 56 yards and two TDs on Nov 22, out-targeting Emeka Egbuka. He is a popular Week 12 waiver add, and analysts call Tampa Bay's receiver pecking order wide open.

players.name: Stefon Diggs
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (personal) as of 3:37 PM PT Nov 25. Earlier: Diggs caught 4 of 6 targets for 45 yards in the 22-20 MNF win over Cincinnati on Nov 23. Rookie Antonio Williams (9-122) led Washington's receivers and set up the winning field goal.

players.name: Puka Nacua
players.note: Week 12 reports on Nov 24 put Nacua's recovery from MCL surgery at four to five months, and Sean McVay said the Rams should plan as though Nacua will not be available. He is also serving a three-game suspension.

players.name: Marvin Harrison Jr.
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (hamstring) as of 6:25 AM PT Nov 25. Earlier: Harrison (hamstring) missed Week 11, and Week 12 reports as of Nov 24 conflict: Footballguys lists him as questionable while Fantasy Index has him out. Tank Dell would see more work if he sits.

players.name: Zachariah Branch
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (hamstring) as of 6:25 AM PT Nov 25. Earlier: Branch (hamstring) missed Weeks 9 and 10. Week 12 injury lists as of Nov 24 still show his status as TBD, and no practice return had been reported.

players.name: Jordyn Tyson
players.note: Tyson had 1 catch for 6 yards on 36 snaps at Chicago on Nov 22, and FantasySP named him a Week 12 drop candidate. Kellen Moore blamed personnel sequencing for his limited snaps.

players.name: Konata Mumpfield
players.note: With Puka Nacua out for the season and Davante Adams (IR) unlikely to play in Week 12, Mumpfield is a top beneficiary in the Rams' thin receiver room and a popular waiver add before Wednesday's game vs. Green Bay (Nov 25).

players.name: Ricky Pearsall
players.note: Week 12 injury roundups as of Nov 24 list Pearsall (IR) as out for the season.

players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was out) as of 6:25 AM PT Nov 25.

players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 1:47 PM PT Nov 22.
